description: 한국도로공사_영업소 차로 운영현황 [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국도로공사. 본 데이터는 한국도로공사에서 제공하는 전국 고속도로 영업소의 차로 운영현황 정보를 조회할 수 있는 OpenAPI 서비스이다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국도로공사. Its tags are 고속도로, 차로, 운영현황, 톨게이트, 기기구분. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-08-11 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
